about: Authored schema for this lane only. Battle flow as an explicit state machine so an animation can never run while the logic is in the wrong phase (e.g. a faint cannot be skipped because damage was calculated late). No third-party code staged; the statechart pattern is the generic technique also used by XState (MIT, see xstate-tool-note).
rules: MOVE_ANIMATION is the only state that plays attack/hurt clips; MENU never animates a strike.
CHECK_FAINT runs after every exchange, before the next MENU — damage arithmetic and fainting are never reordered past an animation.

A deferred-transition queue holds the next state when an event arrives mid-animation; it never jumps straight to it (same next-state-queue idea as the public battle-controller write-ups found this pass).
The battle timeline schema (step2, existing) supplies the event list inside MOVE_ANIMATION; this machine supplies the phase around it.
Skip / 2x playback compresses durations inside MOVE_ANIMATION only; it never skips CHECK_FAINT or BATTLE_OVER.

wiring_target.target_module: battle view / battle controller: replace ad-hoc phase booleans with this machine; treatments module keeps owning durations
